kata.name: Abstract-factory unrealized kind - bench is declared in the product-kind vocabulary but no concrete factory realizes it
kata.series_report: docs/ref/pattern-kata-dispositions.md row Abstract Factory (`disposed — construction only; no invariant on a finite instance`); fixtures/katas/abstract-factory/README.md (pre-registered); beads catherine-r5k.1
kata.series_verdict: pre-registered: the null kind_witness cell names the unrealized kind as an executed dangling finding; the frozen kind list predates bench (survived, scoped to declared kinds)

expected.detail: Kind declares bench with kind_witness = null and no Cell row names bench: T2 (every declared kind is realized somewhere) fails as an executed dangling finding on the kind_witness cell. The frozen kind sample lists only the pre-bench kinds

commands: python3 prototype/abstract_factory_baseline.py --assert  # exit 0: sample kinds chair, sofa, table; bench is outside the frozen list
cargo run -q -p catherine-cli -- check fixtures/katas/abstract-factory/04-unrealized-kind.ct.json --json  # exit 4, 1 dangling

comparison.conventional_baseline: the frozen five-pair sample and the frozen kind list (chair, sofa, table) pass; bench is outside both, so the conventional arm never asks whether it is realized.

baseline.artifact: prototype/abstract_factory_baseline.py sha256:4f635702ad371a9c1155965763f18e2fda0d8a6289455fb708fe60e2dcb07c97 (frozen per-fixture (factory, kind) sample; always executed before the probe arm)

expressibility_gap.invariant: every declared product kind is realized by at least one concrete factory
expressibility_gap.why: expressible only because the model authors one kind_witness cell per Kind row; the kernel has no existential/coverage form, so a kind omitted from both Kind and the witness table is invisible. The universal per-factory direction (every factory realizes every kind) remains G1

expressibility_gap.invariant: the kind witness points at a cell of the same kind
expressibility_gap.why: kind_witness ; cell_kind = id_Kind cannot be written: the kernel rejects an empty equation path, so no identity path exists (G3). The fixture keeps every witness agreeing; the gap is named, not tested

discrepancies: The seed is a stale kind list (a conventional test written before the bench kind was added). A conventional test that enumerated Kind rows would catch it; the survival is a sampling gap.
procedure: 1. The law (AF-T, declared-grid product-family totality) and the fault matrix were committed in fixtures/katas/abstract-factory/ before any recorded run (README.md, faults.json); the pre-registration sections are not edited after the run.

2. The baseline arm (prototype/abstract_factory_baseline.py, sha256 pinned in comparison.baseline.artifact) was executed first: a frozen per-fixture sample of (factory, kind) realization sites asserting exactly one declared Cell, a resolved product, kind agreement, family agreement, plus one coverage assertion per sampled kind. Sites outside the sample are never inspected.

3. The probe arm ran the same fixtures through the real CLI: `catherine check --json`. Witnesses were mapped to presentation elements cell:<Factory>/<Kind> (dangling on cell_product/cell_factory/cell_kind, equation violations on a Cell row, key collisions on the shared site) and kind:<Kind> (dangling on kind_witness).

4. unique_detections = executed probe elements minus baseline-identified elements. The constructed catalog is not consulted (the kata id is unregistered there, so expectations are the pre-registered rows in this record). A construction rejection is recorded but never counted.

5. Verdict follows the recorded rule: empty unique = killed; non-empty unique with an executed baseline arm = survived; a claim resting only on a hypothesis or construction probe would be inconclusive.
